description:
Bridge ACTION: lines in notes/ and logs/ into anchored TASK: lines, and mutate those anchors. Source notes are the store; there is no backend.

Usage with no subcommand: [] ingests every ACTION: line found in notes/ and logs/, validates it, and rewrites it in place as a TASK: anchor with a fresh 8-hex uuid.

Subcommands:
  add THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION (delegates to `buffer add-action`); does not create an anchor until buffer flush + ingest
  done UUID — flip source TASK: to DONE: and stamp end with today's date
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the anchor body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] — list pending tasks, formatted
  next — top 5 pending tasks by (priority, due, entry)
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor

Flags:
  no subcommand: --dry-run show what would be ingested without writing; --quiet suppress per-action output. Both apply only to the no-subcommand invocation.
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char UUID prefix, repeatable.
  list: --priority one of H, M, L; --thread THREAD filters on the source note's thread, e.g. Processes/SGB; --assignee PERSON; --overdue restricts to due dates before today.

UUID arguments accept an 8-hex uuid or a unique prefix of one.

Examples:
  ["--dry-run"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--overdue", "--assignee", "Riaz Arbi"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  All mutating subcommands rewrite the source note or log file in place.
  Exit 1 on: uuid prefix not found; uuid prefix ambiguous (message lists candidates); person does not resolve to people/<person>.md; empty description; a task depending on itself.
  `add` only stages into buffer.md — run `buffer flush` then `tasks` with no subcommand to get an anchor with a uuid.
